title: Government whistleblowers claim UFO retrievals

tellings.quote: their government whistleblowers coming out of saying that they've retrieved UFOs one of whom I've had on my show and like you know it's kind of hard to park poke holes in his story

plain: Whistleblowers from inside the government have come forward to say the United States has recovered UFOs, Michels says. He has had one of them on his show, he adds, and finds it hard to poke holes in that man's story. He says this in an episode about Plato's cave and consciousness, as a reason to take the question seriously.
